headline_findings.key_result: RandomForest_150 achieved the best BUILDINGID accuracy
headline_findings.interpretation: Building prediction is highly reliable under clean validation conditions.

headline_findings.key_result: RandomForest_150 achieved the best FLOOR accuracy
headline_findings.interpretation: Floor prediction is more difficult than building prediction, but Random Forest performs strongest.

headline_findings.key_result: KNNRegressor_5_distance achieved the lowest mean positioning error
headline_findings.interpretation: KNN is the strongest coordinate baseline and becomes the measurement model for filtering.

headline_findings.key_result: 10 dBm RSSI noise increased KNN coordinate mean error
headline_findings.interpretation: Pure RSSI noise caused moderate degradation compared with missing-WAP corruption.

headline_findings.key_result: 30% missing detected WAPs strongly increased KNN coordinate mean error
headline_findings.interpretation: The model depends heavily on sparse detected access-point signals.

headline_findings.key_result: Particle filtering slightly improved 20% missing-WAP scenario
headline_findings.interpretation: The improvement is small but suggests probabilistic smoothing can help severe missing-signal cases.

headline_findings.key_result: Raw KNN remained best for clean and pure-noise scenarios
headline_findings.interpretation: Filtering is limited because the dataset is not a true continuous trajectory dataset.
